cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# PPLRecomp: a native PC port of Pokémon Puzzle League (N64, USA). Inputs (see docs/building.md):
#   - build/: generated by tools/gen_config.py + N64Recomp + RSPRecomp (RecompiledFuncs/, rsp/aspMain.cpp)
#   - N64ModernRuntime and RT64 at the pinned commits (docs/versions.md); by default next to
#     this repository, override with -DPPL_RUNTIME_DIR=... / -DPPL_RT64_DIR=...
# Needs clang-cl on Windows (Visual Studio generator with -T ClangCL).

project(PPLRecomp LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if (CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "3.24.0")
    cmake_policy(SET CMP0135 NEW)
endif()

set(PPL_RUNTIME_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../N64ModernRuntime" CACHE PATH "N64ModernRuntime checkout")
set(PPL_RT64_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../rt64" CACHE PATH "RT64 checkout")
set(PPL_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build" CACHE PATH "Generated inputs (RecompiledFuncs, rsp)")

foreach(required
        "${PPL_RUNTIME_DIR}/librecomp/CMakeLists.txt"
        "${PPL_RT64_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt"
        "${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/RecompiledFuncs/funcs.h"
        "${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/rsp/aspMain.cpp")
    if (NOT EXISTS "${required}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing ${required} (see docs/building.md)")
    endif()
endforeach()

if (WIN32)
    # Opt out of the constexpr mutex constructor to avoid vcredist mismatches.
    add_compile_definitions(_DISABLE_CONSTEXPR_MUTEX_CONSTRUCTOR NOMINMAX)
endif()

set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

# RT64
set(RT64_STATIC TRUE)
if (NOT WIN32)
    set(RT64_SDL_WINDOW_VULKAN TRUE)
    add_compile_definitions(RT64_SDL_WINDOW_VULKAN)
endif()
add_compile_definitions(HLSL_CPU)
add_subdirectory(${PPL_RT64_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rt64)
target_include_directories(rt64 PRIVATE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rt64/src)

# N64ModernRuntime (librecomp, ultramodern)
add_subdirectory(${PPL_RUNTIME_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/N64ModernRuntime)

# fmt 10.2 (bundled by N64Recomp) uses consteval in C++20 in a way clang >= 19 rejects
# when compiling fmt's own format.cc; as C++17 it falls back to constexpr.
if (TARGET fmt)
    set_target_properties(fmt PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17)
endif()

set(PPL_RECOMP_INCLUDES
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/port/include
    ${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}
    ${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/RecompiledFuncs
    ${PPL_RUNTIME_DIR}/N64Recomp/include
    ${PPL_RUNTIME_DIR}/ultramodern/include
    ${PPL_RUNTIME_DIR}/librecomp/include
)

# Recompiled game code
file(GLOB PPL_FUNC_SOURCES ${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/RecompiledFuncs/*.c)
add_library(RecompiledFuncs STATIC ${PPL_FUNC_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(RecompiledFuncs PRIVATE ${PPL_RECOMP_INCLUDES})
target_compile_options(RecompiledFuncs PRIVATE
    -fno-strict-aliasing
    -Wno-unused-variable
    -Wno-unused-but-set-variable
    -Wno-implicit-function-declaration
)

# Executable
add_executable(PPLRecomp
    port/src/main.cpp
    port/src/ppl_dump.cpp
    port/src/ppl_hooks.cpp
    port/src/ppl_s2dex.cpp
    port/src/register_overlays.cpp
    port/src/rt64_context.cpp
    ${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/RecompiledFuncs/lookup.cpp
    ${PPL_GENERATED_DIR}/rsp/aspMain.cpp
)

target_include_directories(PPLRecomp PRIVATE
    ${PPL_RECOMP_INCLUDES}
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/rhi
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/render
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/contrib
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/contrib/hlslpp/include
    ${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/contrib/dxc/inc
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/rt64/src
)

target_compile_options(PPLRecomp PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing)
if (CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|amd64|AMD64")
    target_compile_options(PPLRecomp PRIVATE -march=nehalem)
endif()

if (WIN32)
    include(FetchContent)
    # SDL2 development package from the official SDL releases.
    set(SDL2_VERSION "2.30.3")
    FetchContent_Declare(sdl2
        URL https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-${SDL2_VERSION}/SDL2-devel-${SDL2_VERSION}-VC.zip
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(sdl2)
    target_include_directories(PPLRecomp PRIVATE ${sdl2_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
    target_link_directories(PPLRecomp PRIVATE ${sdl2_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/x64)
    target_link_libraries(PPLRecomp PRIVATE SDL2 Winmm.lib)

    # SDL2 and DXC runtime libraries next to the executable
    add_custom_command(TARGET PPLRecomp POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${sdl2_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/x64/SDL2.dll"
            "${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/contrib/dxc/bin/x64/dxil.dll"
            "${PPL_RT64_DIR}/src/contrib/dxc/bin/x64/dxcompiler.dll"
            $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:PPLRecomp>)

    # Release builds have no console; Debug keeps it for the runtime's logs.
    set_target_properties(PPLRecomp PROPERTIES
        LINK_FLAGS_DEBUG "/SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE"
        LINK_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO "/SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE"
        LINK_FLAGS_RELEASE "/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup"
        LINK_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL "/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup")
else()
    find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_include_directories(PPLRecomp PRIVATE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS})
    target_link_libraries(PPLRecomp PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2 Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()

target_link_libraries(PPLRecomp PRIVATE
    RecompiledFuncs
    librecomp
    ultramodern
    rt64
)
